thread:
Ava (PM): Heads-up: catalog launch checklist for Thurs EOD. Two new models to onboard: 'citrine-7b' (sparse-quant) and 'lode-14b' (faster-attn). Need owners + licensing signoff. Short asks: perf profile, license files, kernel tests, docs, rollout policy.

Ravi (ML Eng): I'll own perf profiles for citrine-7b. ETA Tue. Starting evals against our chat and summarization suites.

Jules (Runtime): I'll own kernel selection and quant artifacts for lode-14b. Question: are the weights in HF format or custom? @Ravi can you upload to model-bucket?

Priya (Legal): Licensing quick check: citrine looks Apache-2, lode is a custom permissive with attribution. Please upload license files to /legal/model-licenses and tag me.

Luca (DevEx): I'll draft quickstart + sample prompts once perf baselines are in. @Ravi tag me on the PR.

Marta (Platform): Rollout plan request: canary 10% -> 100% after 24h if errors < 0.5% and latency within SLO. Also need Dedicated capacity reservation in us-west for lode.

Sam (SRE): Note: lode-14b memory profile ~32GB per replica under default kv-cache settings. We should reserve nodes or enable quantized runtime.

Ravi (ML Eng): PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/model-catalog/pull/482 — perf baselines + eval sets. CI failing on catalog-integ tests, looking into it. @Luca can you review docs diff?

Luca (DevEx): On it, will review today :eyes: 

Priya (Legal): Added license scan results: `licenses/lode_LICENSE.txt` flagged for "attribution required". @Ravi please confirm how you want the metadata to present authorship.

Ravi (ML Eng): Confirmed. Add `model_author: "LodeAI"` and `license_notes: "Requires attribution to LodeAI"` to metadata.

Jules (Runtime): Kernel test results: passed on A100, failing on RTX6000. Error: ```OOM at kv-cache init``` — @Ravi can you test `max_batch_tokens=1024` or enable kv-swap?

Ravi (ML Eng): Will try `max_batch_tokens=1024` and push a patch to the perf branch in 30m.

deploy-bot: Reminder: catalog-prod deploy scheduled 2028-04-12 18:00 UTC. Runbook: /runbooks/catalog-deploy.md

Ava (PM): Thanks all. Owners recap: citrine -> Ravi; lode -> Jules (runtime) + Ravi (perf); legal -> Priya; docs -> Luca; rollout -> Marta. If any blockers surface within 24h, escalate here. :rocket:
